scope: isolated local RGB decoder; no active consumer, platform authorization, model, storage, or Subject authority

contract.input: caller-attested source reference and explicit local video; bounded width/height, frames, bytes, duration and timeout
contract.output: in-memory RGB24, exact FFmpeg integer PTS and time-base plus derived seconds, source/output geometry, declared frame count and count consistency; never caller authorization
contract.timing: FFmpeg showinfo integer PTS × input filter time_base; no fixed-fps reconstruction. Reject nonzero file/video start times, duplicate/missing/out-of-range timestamps, truncation, and missing timing metadata. Count consistency is not proof of complete or correct source.
contract.coordinate_space: decoded scaled pixels with automatic rotation disabled; not original source pixels
contract.privacy: RGB bytes repr-hidden, no logs or persistence; any future temporary files, source checks, withdrawal and cleanup belong to integration

baseline_and_result.fixture: FFmpeg-generated variable frame rate 4-frame video; 0.5s/1.25s/0.25s gaps
baseline_and_result.timing: 5 local runs median 169.266 ms including two FFmpeg processes; cumulative child CPU 0.845s, max child RSS 35712 KiB, not concurrent peak or real production cost

tests.result: 20 passed; includes VFR PTS, exact integer timebase, truncated frames, nonzero offset rejection, duplicate PTS, count mismatch and original dsh source-time mapping

limits: No real source, ASR, VAD, OCR, device, billed provider, true token or production test
Nonzero start offset / VFR duration mismatch / rotation / multi-stream timeline mapping not qualified
No direct Bilibili or current S5 consumer; supplied source reference does not authenticate bytes
Node adapter logs at 0.01s; selected timestamp collisions remain rejected
No memory/CPU benchmark on long or 4K inputs; decoder may hold up to 64 MiB plus one RGB frame in memory
